name: A Hunter's Quiver
summary: Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar needs lion hides for a hunter's quiver. You gather pelts from the lions on the southern hill.

sections.title: A hunter's gear
sections.body: A hunter's weapons need a quiver that holds many arrows without slowing its wearer. Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar asks you to gather prized lion hides for one. The lions hunt in packs, so Neza warns you to watch for being surrounded.

faq.answer: Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar needs prized lion hides for a hunter's quiver.
The lion hides are material for a durable quiver that fits snugly and can hold many arrows without slowing its wearer.
The lions gather on a hill to the south, visible from Rog'mar.

faq.q: Why does Neza want lion pelts?
faq.answer: Neza says lion pelts are well suited to life as a hunter on the plains.
Neza warns that the lions hunt in packs and may surround you.

angles.text: As a hunter, you need a quiver that carries many arrows without slowing you down.
